summary: Iter 202: verified Mobile Signup Parity (Family second-participant block) + Cross-App Resume via shared /api/onboarding/draft on web + mobile. Backend 6/6 pytest pass covering 401 unauth (GET+PUT), full PUT/GET/DELETE round-trip with {tier1,tier2,auth,step}, 413 for >32KB payload, user-scoped isolation (user A's draft not visible to user B), and cross-app interop shape assertion. Mobile signup: signup-second-participant-block visible only when Family selected; toggling signup-second-participant-toggle reveals signup-second-participant-first-name + 9 relationship chips (rel-daughter, rel-son, rel-spouse_partner, ...); switching to Solo hides+resets block, back to Family shows block with fields collapsed (state reset confirmed). Mobile onboarding Cross-App Resume KEY TEST: pre-seeded a draft via API for a fresh signup {tier1.first_name='CrossApp', tier1.last_name='Resume', dob=1948-04-11, pension_status=full_pension, class=4, provider='BlueBerry Care', delivery=email, auth.confirmed=true, step=2}; opened /onboarding on the Expo mobile preview — onboarding-draft-status pill showed 'We restored your saved progress', progress-2 was active, onboarding-step-authorisation rendered, and clicking onboarding-step2-back navigated to step-essentials with all Tier1 fields correctly hydrated (CrossApp / Resume / 11/04/1948 / Full Age Pension pre-selected). This proves the shared server draft is fully interoperable across web (Onboarding.jsx) and mobile (onboarding.tsx). Web regression: Onboarding.jsx unchanged from iter200/201; still saves+restores drafts via /onboarding/draft with identical shape (verified via source read + shared backend passing all 6 tests). Web Signup.jsx pre-create at /v2/participants (line 213-224) still present, no regression.
critical_code_review_comments: onboarding.tsx:105 spreads draft.tier1 onto local t1 with (t) => ({...t, ...d.tier1}) — if draft was written from web with slightly different keys (extra fields), they'll be preserved on the next PUT round-trip which is intended (opaque data). OK.
onboarding.tsx:107 checks typeof d.auth.confirmed === 'boolean' before applying — good defensive check.

signup.tsx:92-108 second-participant pre-create is wrapped in try/catch and non-fatal — user is not blocked if /v2/participants fails, they can add from Participants later. Mirrors Signup.jsx:213-224 web behaviour. OK.

onboarding_draft.py:77-79 uses len(json.dumps(data)) — this is the serialized JSON length, not raw bytes; if data contains non-ASCII characters the actual UTF-8 byte size could be slightly larger, but the 32KB limit is generous and this is not a practical concern for the ~40 short-string onboarding fields.

Mobile submit was rate-limited during E2E (12 min lockout from earlier pytest signups) so /v2/participants network capture wasn't observed live. Code path is straight-line and verified by review; strongly recommend future testing agents run with a longer inter-signup delay or clear the rate-limit collection to avoid this.

success_rate.frontend: 95% (mobile signup submit was rate-limited but pre-submit UI + code path verified; cross-app resume fully verified end-to-end)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Signup rate-limit is aggressive (12-min lockout after ~5 attempts from one IP). To capture the /v2/participants pre-create network call live on mobile signup submit, either wait out the rate-limit or add a Playwright route intercept that stubs /auth/signup with a successful token so the pre-create fires deterministically. All other flows (draft CRUD, cross-app resume hydration on mobile, mobile signup UI toggle+fields+chips) are proven and repeatable.
